out.title: Suraj Singh appointed Business Head of Zee Studios
out.summary: Zee Entertainment appointed Suraj Singh as Business Head of Zee Studios and Senior Management Personnel, effective November 10, 2026, on full-time employment.

person.name: Suraj Singh
person.bio: Media and entertainment executive with 24+ years across films, TV, OTT; led Roar of the Lion for Hotstar and worked on M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story.
